character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist throughout this theme's entire music video: smoky lavender undercut with one long side braid, bright amber eyes, with a distinct recognizable face and consistent adult proportions. They are a street medic who runs an underground clinic beneath the neon towers. Signature outfit: a weatherproof graphite jacket with magenta medical LEDs, fitted cargo trousers, and reinforced sneakers. Unique personal keepsake or tool: a compact holographic medical scanner worn on her wrist. Preserve the exact facial features, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, body proportions, outfit silhouette, and defining item in every scene.
consistency_rules: Keep this theme's named visual identity as one fixed protagonist across every scene.
Preserve the exact face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Maintain the signature costume, distinctive accessories, and defining personal item without random redesign.
Do not replace the lead or add another protagonist unless the lyrics explicitly require it.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in rainy megacity street, holographic market, rooftop antenna garden; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with neon cyan, electric blue, magenta, graphite black; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by cinematic wide shot, street-level tracking shot, dramatic low angle; clear subject separation and intentional negative space

camera_guidance.principle: vary shot scale and viewpoint to support the scene; avoid repeating identical framing in consecutive scenes
